credentials.title: Sign in to the cluster
credentials.description: Enter the login and password for this cluster. The password is sent once and is not saved.

device-code.title: Sign in with a device code
device-code.description: Open the link, enter the code below and approve the sign-in. This window closes by itself.

browser-loopback.title: Continue in your browser
browser-loopback.description: A browser window was opened. Finish signing in there; this window closes by itself.

browser-callback.title: Continue in your browser
browser-callback.description: Finish signing in on the identity provider page; you will return here automatically.

paste-redirect.title: Sign in via the browser
paste-redirect.description: Open the sign-in link and finish signing in.
paste-redirect.hint: After signing in, the browser may show a page that fails to open. This is expected: copy the full address from the address bar and paste it below.

secret-fields.title: Sign-in details
secret-fields.description: Enter the details requested by the cluster provider. They are sent once and are not shown again.

manual-token.title: Get a token manually
manual-token.description: Run this command on your computer, where the tools are installed, and paste its output below. Kubron never runs this command.

confirm-exec.title: Run a plugin?
confirm-exec.description: The kubeconfig asks Kubron to run a program on this computer. Run it only if you trust the kubeconfig.

common.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in to finish…

connections.title: My connections
connections.description: Clusters you are signed in to. Disconnecting removes your saved sign-in and closes your open sessions.

gkeOAuth.title: Google sign-in for GKE
gkeOAuth.description: The OAuth client of Google that Kubron uses to sign you in to GKE clusters with your Google account. Without it GKE is signed in with a service account key.
gkeOAuth.secretKept: A secret is saved; leave empty to keep it
gkeOAuth.hint: Create an OAuth client of the "Desktop app" type in Google Cloud (APIs & Services, Credentials). The secret is stored encrypted and is never shown again. A change takes effect after a restart.

state.restart: Saved. Restart Kubron to apply the change.
